description: This Java source file defines the ContactMechServices class, providing services for managing contact mechanisms such as creating, updating, deleting, and copying contact info like addresses and phone numbers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContactMechServices
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing contact mechanisms such as addresses and phone numbers within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createContactMech
methods.description: Creates a new contact mechanism (address, phone, etc.) with security checks and handles different contact mech types.

methods.name: updateContactMech
methods.description: Updates an existing contact mechanism by creating a new one with the changes, maintaining data integrity.

methods.name: deleteContactMech
methods.description: Marks a contact mechanism as inactive by setting its 'thruDate', effectively deleting it.

methods.name: createPostalAddress
methods.description: Creates a postal address contact mechanism.

methods.name: updatePostalAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing postal address contact mechanism.

methods.name: updateTelecomNumber
methods.description: Updates an existing telecom contact mechanism.

methods.name: createEmailAddress
methods.description: Creates an email address contact mechanism.

methods.name: updateEmailAddress
methods.description: Updates an email address contact mechanism.

methods.name: createPartyContactMechPurpose
methods.description: Creates a purpose association for a contact mechanism for a party.

methods.name: getPartyContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps for a party.

methods.name: copyPartyContactMechs
methods.description: Copies all contact mechanisms from one party to another.

methods.name: createEmailAddressVerification
methods.description: Creates an email address verification record with a generated hash and expiration.
